title: The 10 Best Air Purifiers for Allergies
h1: The 10 Best Air Purifiers for Allergies
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for air purifiers for allergies, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at air purifiers for allergies using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Coway Airmega AP-1512HH Mighty True HEPA Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: 246 smoke CADR covers rooms up to ~360 sq ft, True HEPA rated 99.97% at 0.3 microns, Washable fabric pre-filter for pet hair.
strengths: 246 smoke CADR gives allergy households real headroom to run on a quiet low speed rather than a loud maximum one
Washable pre-filter meaningfully extends HEPA filter life in homes with shedding pets
Eco mode shuts the fan off after 30 minutes of clean air and restarts on rising particle counts, cutting running hours automatically
43 dB maximum keeps it usable overnight in a bedroom, which is where allergy filtration matters most
limitations: 230 dollars at list, roughly double a Levoit Core 300 for coverage under twice the area
Optical particle sensor responds well to visible smoke and less reliably to fine pollen-scale particulate
Includes an ionizer that should be switched off, and the setting doesn't always persist through a power cycle
Filter change indicator runs on a fixed timer rather than actual filter loading
features: 246 smoke CADR covers rooms up to ~360 sq ft
True HEPA rated 99.97% at 0.3 microns
Washable fabric pre-filter for pet hair
Real activated carbon layer, not a coating
Eco mode with particle-sensor auto shutoff
43 dB max, ~24 dB on speed one

products.name: Honeywell HPA300 True HEPA Allergen Remover
products.blurb: Key specs: 300 pollen CADR, highest in this price tier, True HEPA filtration, 99.97% at 0.3 microns, Turbo Clean setting for rapid particle knockdown.
strengths: A 300 pollen CADR beats nearly every competitor in its price range, which matters most during spring and fall spikes
True HEPA rating is documented on the spec sheet rather than described vaguely as HEPA-type
Exposed filter design without a plastic cage means more usable filtration surface per dollar
Filters are widely stocked third-party and genuine, so five-year cost stays predictable
limitations: Louder than the Coway or Levoit at equivalent output, noticeably so at speed three
Boxier plastic housing looks and feels less premium than the Coway's build
No washable pre-filter, so all hair and large debris load directly onto the HEPA media
Auto mode's sensor reacts more to visible particles than to fine pollen dust
features: 300 pollen CADR, highest in this price tier
True HEPA filtration, 99.97% at 0.3 microns
Turbo Clean setting for rapid particle knockdown
Exposed pleated filter with no plastic cage
3 fan speeds plus auto and sleep settings

products.name: Blueair Blue Pure 411 Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: HEPASilent filtration combining mechanical and electrostatic capture, As low as 17 dB on low speed, Washable fabric pre-filter cover in several colors.
strengths: 17 dB minimum noise is close to silent, making it the easiest unit here to sleep beside
HEPASilent design reaches strong particle capture without the fan noise a purely mechanical filter needs at the same CADR
Washable fabric pre-filter swaps out for a fresh look and adds a first line of defense against large debris
Compact enough for a nightstand without dominating a small bedroom
Low running cost keeps it cheap to operate continuously, which is how allergy purifiers should be run
limitations: Limited coverage of roughly 190 sq ft means it is bedroom-only, not a living-room solution
No true carbon layer of note, so it does little for odors
No auto mode or particle sensor, fan speed is manual
features: HEPASilent filtration combining mechanical and electrostatic capture
As low as 17 dB on low speed
Washable fabric pre-filter cover in several colors
Compact footprint sized for nightstands
True HEPA capture at 99.97% efficiency

products.name: Winix 5500-2 True HEPA Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: 232 smoke CADR covers rooms up to ~350 sq ft, Washable AOC carbon pre-filter, True HEPA filtration.
strengths: Washable AOC carbon pre-filter extends HEPA filter life meaningfully in pet and allergy households
232 smoke CADR is genuine mid-size coverage at a price well below the Coway
Auto mode with a real particle sensor and numeric readout gives visible feedback on room conditions
Lower five-year filter cost than most true-HEPA competitors thanks to the washable component
limitations: PlasmaWave ionizer should be switched off for allergy and asthma households, and the menu to disable it is not obvious
Plastic housing feels less substantial than the Coway's
Louder at top speed than the Coway or Blueair 411 at comparable output
Washing the AOC filter is an extra maintenance step some owners skip, which shortens HEPA life
features: 232 smoke CADR covers rooms up to ~350 sq ft
Washable AOC carbon pre-filter
True HEPA filtration
PlasmaWave ionization (disable for allergy use)
4 fan speeds plus auto and sleep modes

products.name: Blueair Blue Pure 211+ Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: 350 smoke CADR covers ~540 sq ft, HEPASilent filtration technology, Washable fabric pre-filter cover.
strengths: 350 smoke CADR is enough real capacity for an open-plan living space, not just a bedroom
Single large fan reaches high CADR while staying under 56 dB even at full speed, quieter than smaller units pushed harder
Washable fabric pre-filter cover extends the HEPA filter's usable life and comes in swappable colors
HEPASilent design captures fine particulate without requiring a screaming fan to hit the CADR number
limitations: Larger physical footprint that needs real floor space, not a nightstand fit
No auto mode or particle sensor, fan speed is set manually
Minimal carbon means little help with cooking or pet odor
Higher price than mid-size units for households that don't actually need 540 sq ft of coverage
features: 350 smoke CADR covers ~540 sq ft
HEPASilent filtration technology
Washable fabric pre-filter cover
Single large fan stays under 56 dB at max
True HEPA capture at 99.97%

products.name: Levoit Vital 100 True HEPA Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: Wide intake designed to handle fur and large debris, True HEPA filtration for rooms up to ~300 sq ft, 24 dB sleep mode.
strengths: Wide, fur-ready intake is specifically well suited to shedding pets rather than a generic HEPA opening
Since pet dander is a large particle, filtration efficiency is not the limiting factor here, and this unit is built around that reality
24 dB sleep mode is quiet enough for a bedroom shared with a pet
Compact footprint makes it easy to place near a pet's usual resting spot without crowding the room
limitations: No washable pre-filter, so fur and dander load directly onto the primary filter and shorten its life
Thin carbon coating does little for pet odor beyond the first few weeks after a filter change
No auto mode, so speed must be bumped manually after vacuuming or a shedding session
Coverage tops out around 300 sq ft, undersized for open pet-friendly living areas
features: Wide intake designed to handle fur and large debris
True HEPA filtration for rooms up to ~300 sq ft
24 dB sleep mode
Display panel with fan speed indicator
Compact cylindrical design

products.name: Levoit Core 300 True HEPA Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: 141 smoke CADR covers ~215 sq ft, True HEPA at 99.97% capture, 24 dB sleep mode.
strengths: Genuine true HEPA at under 110 dollars, cheapest legitimate option for an allergy bedroom
24 dB sleep mode is quiet enough that most owners stop noticing it within a day
360-degree intake is far more forgiving about placement in a cramped bedroom than rear-intake rectangular units
No ionizer means no ozone byproduct and nothing to remember to switch off, a real plus for allergy and asthma households
limitations: 141 CADR caps honest coverage at about 215 sq ft, undersized for anything beyond a bedroom or small office
No air quality sensor or auto mode, fan speed is entirely manual
Carbon layer is a thin coating that fades within weeks of a filter change
No washable pre-filter, so pet hair loads directly onto the HEPA media
features: 141 smoke CADR covers ~215 sq ft
True HEPA at 99.97% capture
24 dB sleep mode
360-degree cylindrical intake
No ionizer or ozone byproduct

products.name: Austin Air HealthMate HM400 Standard Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: 15 lbs of granular activated carbon plus 4 lbs of zeolite, Welded steel body, no plastic off-gassing, Medical-grade HEPA rated for particulate down to 0.1 micron.
strengths: 15 pounds of granular carbon is a magnitude beyond any carbon coating in this category, and it's the only unit here that meaningfully handles gases and chemical off-gassing, not just particulate
Welded steel construction with no plastic housing means the purifier itself doesn't off-gas, which matters specifically for chemical sensitivity buyers
Medical-grade HEPA rated down to 0.1 micron exceeds the standard 0.3 micron true HEPA benchmark
5-year warranty reflects genuinely industrial build quality uncommon at consumer prices
No ionizer, UV lamp, or plasma feature to worry about disabling
limitations: 45 pounds and a large drum shape make it the least portable unit on this list by a wide margin
No digital display, sensor, or auto mode; it is a manual on/off/speed machine
Most expensive purifier here relative to its HEPA-only CADR performance, since the price is paying for the carbon
Replacement filters cost significantly more than any HEPA-only competitor and are needed roughly every 3 to 5 years
features: 15 lbs of granular activated carbon plus 4 lbs of zeolite
Welded steel body, no plastic off-gassing
Medical-grade HEPA rated for particulate down to 0.1 micron
No ionizer, UV, or plasma additions
5-year manufacturer warranty on the housing

products.name: Coway Airmega 400 Smart Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: Max2 true HEPA and carbon filter stack, Smart app control with real-time PM2.5 readout, Auto mode driven by a laser particle sensor.
strengths: Laser particle sensor is a meaningful step up from the optical sensors in cheaper Coway and Levoit units, giving genuinely responsive auto mode
App control with real-time PM2.5 numbers turns the purifier into an actual air quality monitor, not just a filter
Max2 filter combines true HEPA and carbon in one cartridge, simplifying replacement
Large-room capacity means it can run on a low, quiet speed in a mid-size space rather than maxed out
limitations: Price sits well above the AP-1512HH for buyers who don't need the extra coverage or app features
App dependency means Wi-Fi setup and occasional firmware quirks that a purely mechanical unit doesn't have
No washable pre-filter component separate from the main cartridge, unlike the AP-1512HH
Smaller rating base than Coway's own budget model, reflecting a smaller buyer pool at this price
features: Max2 true HEPA and carbon filter stack
Smart app control with real-time PM2.5 readout
Auto mode driven by a laser particle sensor
Large-room coverage rated to ~1,560 sq ft (mfr) / ~525 sq ft honest
Filter replacement indicator tied to actual air quality data

products.name: Levoit Core 400S Smart True HEPA Air Purifier
products.blurb: Key specs: ~260 smoke CADR covers ~400 sq ft, Wi-Fi app control and scheduling, Particle sensor with numeric AQI display.
strengths: Real particle sensor with a numeric air quality display gives genuine feedback, not just a status light
App scheduling lets the unit ramp down automatically overnight, which suits continuous allergy-season operation
260 smoke CADR covers a genuinely mid-size room, wider than the base Core 300
Quieter than the Winix 5500-2 at equivalent fan speeds
limitations: Costs meaningfully more than the Core 300 for buyers who don't need Wi-Fi or auto mode
App dependency adds a setup step and occasional connectivity friction that manual units avoid
Same thin carbon coating as the Core 300, so odor performance is still limited
Proprietary filter cartridge not shared with other Core-series models
features: ~260 smoke CADR covers ~400 sq ft
Wi-Fi app control and scheduling
Particle sensor with numeric AQI display
True HEPA filtration
Quiet operation at equivalent fan speeds vs. Winix
